description: The documentation sections one control publishes — overview, installation, canvas, model_driven, examples, limitations and so on — each with its title and URL. Use it before get_doc_page to learn which sections that control actually has; it returns no page content, and get_component covers the property reference. A control with no documentation and a slug that does not exist return the same error on purpose, so fall back to search rather than concluding the slug is wrong.
name: list_doc_sections

section.description: Pass to get_doc_page as its section argument.

title.description: The section's heading, as the author wrote it.

slug.description: The control the sections belong to.

title: List a control's documentation
